blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Friday filed a complaint before the Office of the Ombudsman against Commission on Human Rights (CHR) chair Richard Palpal-latoc and three others for alleged graft. According to a portion of the document shared to reporters, the Public Corruption Division of the NBI filed a complaint against Palpal-latoc, Onesimo Cuyco, Maria Teresa Dolor, and Russel Mani. “Respectfully transmitting for Preliminary Investigation are the results of the investigation conducted by this Bureau’s Public Corruption Division,” read the complaint addressed to Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla.
